mapper.select: SELECT id, company_code, company_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM dbo.companies WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, company_code, company_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM dbo.companies WHERE company_code = #{code}

SELECT id, company_code, company_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM dbo.companies WHERE tax_code = #{taxCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.companies ( id, company_code, company_name, tax_code, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_job_title, note, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{companyCode}, #{companyName}, #{taxCode}, #{address}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactJobTitle}, #{note}, #{status}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SYSUTCDATETIME() )
